newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end higher but off day's peaks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end higher but off day's peaks.

text.p: Aug 18 - U.S. debt futures ended higher but off the day's peaks amid light trade. One analyst said market nervously watched U.S. stocks after Friday's steep slide. As Dow perked up in afternoon, Sept T-bond came off its high. One futures firm reportedly sold at least 4,000 5-yr note futures. One trader said players beginning to mull impact of UPS strike. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750))
